Questions

Common questions.

Does it work with our existing POS hardware?

Usually yes. We integrate with POS hardware and inventory systems already in use, or supply the POS as part of the system.

Can distributors use it without training?

The distributor portal is built for phones and takes minutes to learn: place an order, track it, report sales.

What data does forecasting need?

Ideally 12 months or more of sales by product; distributor and seasonal data improve accuracy.
